newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha loses ground, waits for crude to settl.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha loses ground, waits for crude to settl.

text.p: NWE naphtha continued to lose ground on Tuesday amidst poor petchem demand and flagging crude.
"Buyers are not really out there," said one trader.
Swaps talk was a touch more active than physical with Jan pegged down around $224, off $4 or so, and February at $220-221. Dealers said Jan was done early in the day at $226.50.
A Russian cargo was heard available which attracted a bid of $220 cif Antwerp, but the deal was not done. Two other Russian open spec cargoes were also available.
Light virgin material was still able to attract premiums of +$4-4.50 on cif quotes cif Antwerp.
